about: Thirty questions for the ask box with the query each should become. Ten must be refused. Written before either translator, and not edited to suit one. A field that is a list accepts any value in it. For comparison 'team' the pair (team, compare_to) may come in either order; the same for 'season'.

about_reworded: The same thirty intents put another way. Written by a separate model session that was given only each item's meaning (team or player, situation, what is measured, season, kind of question) and the team list, and that had seen neither the wording above nor any code. Each was read for meaning before any translator was run on it, and none was edited. Expected queries are those of the item with the same id.
